protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. Attacker-controlled Hermit depName/version values form toPackage/packagesToInstall without shell quoting, then enter `./hermit install ${...}`; Renovate's exec() reaches promisified child_process.exec, so shell metacharacters execute. The vendor advisory independently states the same unescaped install/uninstall mechanism.
